title: Myomo to Attend the 17th Annual Craig Hallum Alpha Select Conference
summary: Myomo announces participation in the 17th Annual Craig Hallum Alpha Select Conference. Meet their leaders and learn more.
body_markdown:
**BURLINGTON, Mass. (November 3, 2026) – Myomo, Inc. (NYSE American: MYO)** (“Myomo” or the “Company”), a wearable medical robotics company that offers increased functionality for those suffering from neurological disorders and upper-limb paralysis, today announced its participation at the 17th Annual Craig Hallum Alpha Select Conference being held Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at the Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel. Myomo’s President and Chief Executive Officer Paul Gudonis, Chief Financial Officer David Henry and Chief Commercial Officer Katie McClure will participate in one-on-one meetings throughout the event.


Investors interested in scheduling a meeting with the Company should contact their Craig Hallum representative.[Read More.](https://myomo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/CH-Conference-PR-Final.pdf)
